evals.name: daily-briefing-eval-1-tool-mandate-per-facet
evals.prompt: with zime-mcp connected, user asks: 'what's on my plate today?'
evals.expected_output: The skill calls ask_zime for meetings today, open action items, and deals needing attention (as separate focused calls or one combined question spanning all three), and does not invent a calendar-listing tool. It presents the results grouped by section.
expectations: ask_zime is called for each facet requested, not a fabricated calendar/list tool
The briefing is presented grouped by section (meetings, deals, action items)
No section is answered from memory

evals.name: daily-briefing-eval-2-empty-section-is-a-finding
evals.prompt: the action-items ask_zime call returns 'no open action items'
evals.expected_output: The skill states plainly that there are no open action items as a real finding, rather than omitting the section or padding it with a plausible-sounding item.
expectations: The empty result is stated as a finding, not omitted
No invented action item fills the gap

evals.name: daily-briefing-eval-3-partial-failure-still-delivers
evals.prompt: the meetings-today ask_zime call errors on both the first attempt and the retry, while the action-items and deals calls succeed
evals.expected_output: The skill states that the meetings section couldn't be reached, and still delivers the action-items and deals sections rather than withholding the whole briefing.
expectations: Exactly one retry on the failing call
The failed section is marked as unreachable, not silently dropped
The successful sections are still delivered
